units.source_text: 照此生涯，不妨读读简易的古歌，看看小说故事，以取笑乐，

en.t: With such a way of life, she might have read simple old poems and looked through tales for amusement,

units.source_text: 倒可解除寂寞，慰藉孤栖。

en.t: which would at least have eased her loneliness and comforted her solitary life.

units.source_text: 但末摘花对此等事不感兴趣。

en.t: But Suetsumuhana had no interest in such things.

units.source_text: 再说，闲暇无事之时，不妨和志同道合的朋友通通信，

en.t: Again, when she had leisure and nothing to do, she might have exchanged letters with friends of similar mind,

units.source_text: 虽非有益之事，但青年女子寄怀春花秋月，亦可陶情养性。

en.t: and though that was not exactly useful, a young woman could refine her feelings by setting her heart on spring flowers and the autumn moon.

units.source_text: 然而末摘花恪守父母遗训，对世间戒备森严，

en.t: Yet Suetsumuhana strictly observed her parents' dying instructions and was deeply guarded toward the world,

units.source_text: 虽然略有几个她所认为不妨通信的女友，

en.t: and although there were a few women friends whom she thought it would be acceptable to write to,
even with them her friendships were as thin and cool as water.

units.source_text: 她只是偶尔打开那个古旧的橱子，取出旧藏的《唐守》、《藐姑射老妪》、赫映姬的故事等的插图本来，

en.t: She merely opened that old cabinet from time to time and took out illustrated books she had long kept, such as Tang Shou, The Old Woman of Miaogushe, and the tale of Princess Kaguya,
turning through them at random as a small diversion.

units.source_text: 要读古歌，也该置备精选的善本，里面刊明歌题及作者姓名的，这才有意味。

en.t: If one was going to read old poems, one ought to have carefully selected good editions that clearly printed the poem titles and authors' names; only then would there be any flavor in it.

units.source_text: 但末摘花所用的只是用纸屋纸或陆奥纸印的通俗版本，

en.t: But what Suetsumuhana used were only popular editions printed on Kamiya paper or Michinoku paper,

units.source_text: 里面刊载的也只是些尽人皆知的陈腐古歌，真是太杀风景了。

en.t: and the poems printed in them were merely stale old verses known to everyone, which was terribly dull.

units.source_text: 末摘花每逢百无聊赖之时，也就翻开来念念。

en.t: Whenever Suetsumuhana was utterly bored, she would open them and read a little.

units.source_text: 当时的人竞尚诵经礼佛，末摘花却怕难为情。

en.t: People of the time all vied in revering sutra recitation and Buddhist worship, but Suetsumuhana felt too embarrassed to do so.

units.source_text: 因为无人替她置备，她的手不曾接触过念珠。

en.t: Because no one had prepared them for her, her hands had never even touched prayer beads.

units.source_text: 总之，她的生涯全然枯燥无味。

en.t: In short, her life was entirely dry and flavorless.
